text:
alex: Quick idea — try a 30m compact triage Wed 9:30am PT starting next week. Split into two parallel lanes: 15m bug queue (top 10) + 10m release blockers + 5m RFC lightning (1-2 quick reviews). Vote? :raised_hands:

maria: +1 for shorter focused meeting. If we do two lanes, can we pre-populate top 10 in the doc before the call?

sam: yes, i'll maintain bug list this week. i'll add a 'severity/owner' column.

jin: I'm out Wed mornings. any chance Thu 11am works? :grimacing:

tara: Wed 9:30 is fine for me. Agreed on pre-read. We should enforce 2-min owner updates.

alex: plan for pre-read doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/triage/top10 — i'll add template. Proposed agenda block:
```
00:00-00:02 quick context
00:02-00:17 Bug queue (owners give 2-min updates)
00:17-00:27 Release blockers and hotfixes
00:27-00:30 RFC lightning (1-2 quick asks, 3 slides max)
```

nate: can we add an explicit 'assign owner' step per bug? Sometimes things sit unassigned.

sam: yes will add an assign column. also +1 to 2-min cap, use a timer.

eng-bot: Calendar updated: "Triage (compact pilot)" Wed 09:30 PT — invites sent to eng@redwood.com

maria: volunteer to be meeting runbook owner for pilot (will enforce timebox). :hand:

jin: I can join occasionally; ok with async updates when I can't. Please ping owners 1 day prior.

alex: thanks — action items: sam populate top10 by Tue EOD, maria run pilot for 3 weeks, alex update calendar and runbook. Anyone object? :thinking:

tara: no objections. :thumbsup:

nate: sounds good.

sam: done — i'll post the pre-read by Tue 6pm and tag owners.

eng-bot: Reminder set: owners ping 24h before meeting

alex: ok closing thread. We'll start Wed next week. If any major conflicts, DM me. :rocket:
